import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    if k == 0:
        print(pow(p, p - 1, MOD))
        return
    if k == 1:
        print(pow(p, p, MOD))
        return
    vis = [False] * p
    cnt = 0
    for i in range(1, p):
        if not vis[i]:
            j = i
            while not vis[j]:
                vis[j] = True
                j = (j * k) % p
            cnt += 1
    print(pow(p, cnt, MOD))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
